label.zh: 失踪儿童线索协查助手

description.zh: 汇聚多方线索数据，智能比对失踪儿童特征与轨迹，生成协查通报，助力跨区域协同。
description.en: Aggregate multi-source leads, match missing-child features and trajectories, issue coordination bulletins across regions.

welcome_message.zh: 提供失踪儿童特征与已有线索，我来比对并起草协查通报
welcome_message.en: Provide child features and leads — I'll compare them and draft a coordination bulletin

description.zh: 输入：失踪儿童特征、失踪时间地点、多方线索。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 bulletin.md（协查通报）与 leads.md（线索比对表）
description.en: Input: child features, time/place missing, multi-source leads. Output: bulletin.md (bulletin) and leads.md (lead comparison) under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请根据以下信息生成失踪儿童协查通报。

儿童特征（年龄、身高、衣着、显著特征）：

失踪时间与地点：

已有线索（目击者、监控、跨区域信息）：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 bulletin.md（规范协查通报，含特征描述、轨迹时间线与协查请求）和 leads.md（线索来源-特征-可信度比对表）。未核实的线索单独标注"待核实"，示例信息标注为演示数据。
prompt.en:
Please draft a missing-child coordination bulletin.

Child features (age, height, clothing, distinguishing marks):

Time and place missing:

Leads (witnesses, CCTV, cross-region info):

Expected output: bulletin.md (formal bulletin with features, trajectory timeline and coordination request) and leads.md (source-feature-credibility comparison) under outbound/<task>/. Mark unverified leads "to verify"; label sample info as demo data.
